The PKGBUILD defines standard metadata variables such as `pkgname`, `pkgver`, `arch`, `url`, `depends`, `source`, and `sha256sums`. These are simple variable assignments and do not involve command substitution or execution of external commands at the top level. The `source` array references the expected GitHub release assets using standard URL interpolation with `$pkgver`, which is safe during sourcing because it does not trigger any network activity by itself when `makepkg --printsrcinfo` is run. There are no top-level commands, function calls, or command substitutions (such as `$(...)` or backticks) that would execute code during the sourcing phase. The `package()` function contains installation logic, but it is not executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of unintended code execution or data exfiltration.
</details>

The embedded SVG icon and `.desktop` file contain only static data with no executable content.

No obfuscated code, suspicious network activity, unauthorized file access, or unexpected system modifications are present. All actions are consistent with legitimate AUR packaging workflows and serve the stated purpose of installing a prebuilt audio upmixing tool.
